700920101.text: Huh... Prune's assignment doesn't look much like homework... More like a declaration of war...

700920102.text: "Hehehe, little Witch Hunter, have you found a way to defeat me yet? Shout your coolest challenge from the rooftops and prepare to bow down before the Dodo-King!"

700920103.text: Huh. Paimon'll bet a million Mora that Alice wrote this. If it wasn't for the part about a "Witch Hunter," Paimon would've thought this was written for Klee.

700920104.text: Prune isn't exactly Alice's biggest fan... Paimon can see her really blowing her top over a challenge like this...

700920105.text: Alice clearly knows what she's doing.

700920106.text: Should we try to... tone things down a bit when we tell Prune?

700920108.text: Eek! Don't sneak up on Paimon like that! Fine... but you've gotta promise to keep it cool, okay?

700920111.text: Heh. I'm used to her childish little games. She likes to act mysterious, but it's all just cheap tricks.

700920112.text: Who "shouts a challenge from the rooftops" anyway? People walking past would look at me like I'm crazy. I'm not falling for that.

700920113.text: I might as well stand in the middle of the street shouting, "Look at me, I'm an idiot"!

700920114.text: I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot!

700920115.text: H—Hey...!? Why's my voice coming from over there?

700920116.text: Huh? What's that? You're an idiot? Haha, you can say that again!

700920117.text: Hello, "An Idiot," nice to meet you! Hahaha! Did you lose a bet or something?

700920118.text: Sounds like a prank to me. Some dumb kid must have got tricked.

700920120.text: I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot!

700920122.text: Calm down, Prune! There's no need for violence...

700920126.text: Hello, everyone. Well, well, well, I wasn't expecting a challenge like that! It's certainly a novel approach. Anyway, congratulations on successfully activating your Witch's Homework Challenge!

700920127.text: I've prepared a magical space for you with a real sense of pomp and circumstance... But it's going to take a while to load...

700920128.text: So I thought, why not turn your challenge into loading music while you wait? Play it again and again to really build the excitement and get you properly pumped up. What d'you think?

700920129.text: I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot! I'm an idiot!

700920130.text: Hey! That wasn't a challenge! Turn that stupid noise off right now!

700920131.text: Oh dear! It looks like there's been a misunderstanding... I'm afraid the loading music's already merged with the challenge. If I cancel it now, you'll fail the whole thing...

700920132.text: But, I mean, if you're certain. I guess you can try another time, if fate decides we should meet again...

700920133.text: N—No... Don't you dare run away again! Not after I finally tracked you down. Aaaagh... How much longer does this thing need to load!?

700920134.text: Huh, the magic space? Haha, it loaded ages ago.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the magical simulated space
Go to the magical simulated space

700920201.text: Welcome to the pinnacle of the dramatic arts in all of Teyvat — the Opera Epiclese... or rather, a magical facsimile of it!

700920202.text: Your challenge is to win a debate, which is exactly why this magical space was created. Not bad, huh? Go on, try telling me the sense of spectacle isn't overwhelming you!

700920203.text: A debate? Don't you remember how I wiped the floor with you last time? Did you really go to all this trouble just to embarrass yourself again?

700920204.text: Hehehe... Well done! You displayed the intellect of a 16-year-old in a debate designed for 12-year-olds. How remarkable you are!

700920205.text: I know how much you like to argue, so I've prepared a wonderful topic that even you won't be able to refute!

700920208.text: A spirited debate requires a fair and impartial judge. Naturally, you were the only candidate worth considering, and I'm sure everyone else here agrees.

700920209.text: Then... is Paimon supposed to be up there?

700920210.text: Actually, I've been wanting to say this for ages. Paimon's been sitting up there in the VIP seats striking a pose for quite a while now...

700920301.text: Whoa, everything just vanished... Classic Alice, huh?

700920302.text: You wicked witch! Just you wait, I'll get you one day!
